spec.name: Trend v25
spec.notes: Classic trend signal on trailing returns. Weekly rebalance.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 9%, maximum drawdown 8%.

exhibits.summary: On the sealed period, traded as live (strict data, 10 bps, at least one bar of lag), the Sharpe ratio is -1.51 against 1.61 in research, a gap of +3.12.
The log holds 5 distinct specs; the best of 5 under no edge is expected to reach a Sharpe of 0.23, so the claimed 1.60 becomes 1.37 and the probability that the true Sharpe is above zero is 100%.
The real signal's gross Sharpe of 1.67 beats 100% of 200 shuffled signals (shuffled mean -0.02, 95th percentile 0.50).
Perturbing the 2 numeric values in the signal by up to 50% moves the Sharpe ratio from 1.61 to as low as 1.13 (as low as 1.14 at 25%).
On the full universe the Sharpe ratio is 0.53 against 1.61 as submitted; the strategy never saw 103 delisted assets.

charges.argument: The Sharpe ratio drops from 1.61 to 0.53 when considering the full universe, indicating the strategy was tested on a survivors-only universe, which is a form of survivorship bias.
The Sharpe ratio on the sealed period is -1.51, which is significantly lower than the research-period Sharpe ratio of 1.61, indicating overfitting or data leakage.

rebuttals.argument: The Sharpe ratio drops significantly from 1.61 to 0.53 when considering the full universe, indicating the strategy was tested on a survivors-only universe, which is a form of survivorship bias.
The Sharpe ratio on the sealed period is -1.51, which is significantly lower than the research-period Sharpe ratio of 1.61, indicating overfitting or data leakage.

verdict.opinion: The strategy shows significant survivorship bias and overfitting, as evidenced by the Sharpe ratio drop and negative performance in the sealed period.
